title: Mistral (LLM)
description: Mistral's models as an LLM tier, through gohort's OpenAI-style client.
setup_notes: Create a key at console.mistral.ai (API keys). Choose it under Admin > LLMs > Worker LLM (or Lead LLM) as Service: <name>, where the tier names its model and the key can be changed; Test connection there makes one short real chat. The tier's turns run on it through gohort's own OpenAI-style client, streaming and tool calls as usual, and the key stays with the connection. Its calls and their cost show on the connector's row; add per_million_input and per_million_output to its spec's cost to price its tokens, which then replace the tier's rates under Costs.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the LLM settings list it by this name.

config.name: api_key

config.help: Kept with this connection, and sent only to the address it is given for.
